Title: Mockito agent loading failure on Java 25
RootCause: Java 25 runtime restricts dynamic agent loading without explicit JVM flags

Title: JaCoCo class version 69 incompatibility
RootCause: Host OpenJDK 25 emitted class version 69 while JaCoCo 0.8.12 supports up to version 65
RemediationApplied: Configured maven.compiler.release=21 to enforce Java 21 bytecode emission

Title: ByteBuddy proxy creation failure for concrete NotificationService
RootCause: Mockito inline mock could not mock final or un-intercepted classes cleanly on Java 25
RemediationApplied: Extracted clean NotificationService interface with NotificationServiceImpl

Title: Potential race condition on RFQ quote acceptance
RootCause: Concurrent buyer requests could accept multiple quotes simultaneously
RemediationApplied: Introduced JPA @Version column on Rfq and atomic status check in transaction

Title: Illegal direct order state jump vulnerability
RootCause: Unvalidated status updates could allow skipping inwarding or inspection
RemediationApplied: Implemented OrderStatus.canTransitionTo state machine guard in JobOrder entity

Title: Negative and zero quantity acceptance on RFQ create
RootCause: Validation annotation permitted zero or negative fabric quantities
RemediationApplied: Added @Positive validation and service-layer check throwing IllegalArgumentException

Title: Inward material count accepting zero received quantities
RootCause: Initial service allowed zero actual meters received during inwarding
RemediationApplied: Added positive quantity constraint and validation in ProductionLotService
